dispositions.discriminative_explanation: The observations strongly suggest the entire object, including the 'folds,' is a single, continuous solid mass, which contradicts the idea that differences are caused by carving distinct layers or materials. img-k7-o1 explicitly states the drapery appears 'carved from the same solid material as the body.' img-k7-o3 describes the torso as an 'unadorned section' with a 'smooth plane,' implying the folds are part of the same sculpted whole. img-v9-o0 suggests the folds imply 'rigidity' consistent with carved stone or plaster, not a separate fabric element.
